    if t['duration_unit'] == 'hours':
        total_tg_minutes += t['duration'] * 60
    else:  # minutes
        total_tg_minutes += t['duration']

    if t['duration_unit'] == 'hours':
        dur_min = t['duration'] * 60
    else:
        dur_min = t['duration']
    inbox_with_duration.append((t, dur_min))

# Sort by duration ascending to maximize count
